canonical:
glassbox-canonical 1
version 2
id "loop"
title "One loop of a six-loop looper"
clock beats
initial "empty"
notes 13
  note "Commands, added with the effects fork. Every one of them hangs off a"
  note "STATE rather than an edge, so 'entering Recording starts the recorder' is"
  note "said once and holds for all four ways in."
  note ""
  note "This machine also found the one place the shape is awkward, and it is"
  note "recorded here rather than papered over. Playing -> Overdub emits"
  note "stop-playback then start-overdub, because leaving Playing exits it; a real"
  note "looper wants a handover, not a stop followed by a start. Nothing in the"
  note "format is wrong — the modelling is, and there are two honest fixes. Either"
  note "the host reads the pair as a handover, or overdub stops being a state and"
  note "becomes a fact about Playing. It is exactly the case edge-specific"
  note "commands were held back to wait for, and it is not yet convincing enough"
  note "to add them."
states 6
  state "armed" "Armed" false (entry 1 "start-count-in") (exit 1 "stop-count-in")
  state "empty" "Empty" false (entry 1 "discard-audio") (exit 0)
  state "overdubbing" "Overdub" false (entry 1 "start-overdub") (exit 1 "stop-overdub")
  state "playing" "Playing" false (entry 1 "start-playback") (exit 1 "stop-playback")
  state "recording" "Recording" false (entry 1 "start-recorder") (exit 1 "stop-recorder")
  state "stopped" "Stopped" false (entry 0) (exit 0)
events 5
  event "clear" "clear" user
  event "elapsed" "count-in" runtime
  event "play" "play" user
  event "record" "record" user
  event "stop" "stop" user
config 1
  config "count-in-beats" "Count-in (beats)" (num 4)
facts 1
  fact "converter-held" "Another loop holds the converter"
refusals 3
  refusal "converter-busy" "another loop holds the converter"
  refusal "nothing-yet" "nothing recorded yet"
  refusal "overdub-in-play" "stopped loops overdub from Playing"
commands 9
  command "discard-audio" "Throw away this loop's audio"
  command "start-count-in" "Start the count-in click"
  command "start-overdub" "Start overdubbing onto this loop"
  command "start-playback" "Start playing this loop"
  command "start-recorder" "Start recording"
  command "stop-count-in" "Stop the count-in click"
  command "stop-overdub" "Stop overdubbing"
  command "stop-playback" "Stop playing this loop"
  command "stop-recorder" "Stop recording"
rules 30
  rule "armed" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "armed" "elapsed" (cases 1 (case - (move "recording")))
  rule "armed" "play" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "armed" "record" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "armed" "stop" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "empty" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "empty" "elapsed" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "empty" "play" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "nothing-yet")))
  rule "empty" "record" (cases 3 (case (holds (fact "converter-held")) (refuse "converter-busy")) (case (cmp gt (config "count-in-beats") (lit (num 0))) (move "armed")) (case - (move "recording")))
  rule "empty" "stop" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "overdubbing" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "overdubbing" "elapsed" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "overdubbing" "play" (cases 1 (case - (move "playing")))
  rule "overdubbing" "record" (cases 1 (case - (move "playing")))
  rule "overdubbing" "stop" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "playing" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "playing" "elapsed" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "playing" "play" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "playing" "record" (cases 1 (case - (move "overdubbing")))
  rule "playing" "stop" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "recording" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "recording" "elapsed" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "recording" "play" (cases 1 (case - (move "playing")))
  rule "recording" "record" (cases 1 (case - (move "playing")))
  rule "recording" "stop" (cases 1 (case - (move "stopped")))
  rule "stopped" "clear" (cases 1 (case - (move "empty")))
  rule "stopped" "elapsed" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
  rule "stopped" "play" (cases 1 (case - (move "playing")))
  rule "stopped" "record" (cases 1 (case - (refuse "overdub-in-play")))
  rule "stopped" "stop" (cases 1 (case - (stay)))
deadlines 1
  deadline "armed" "elapsed" (config "count-in-beats")
